record.title: Erdős Problem #648 — Decreasing Greatest Prime Factors
record.statement:
For $n\in\mathbb N$, let $g(n)$ be the largest integer $t$ for which there exist integers
$$2\leq a_1<a_2<\cdots<a_t<n$$
such that their greatest prime factors are strictly decreasing:
$$P(a_1)>P(a_2)>\cdots>P(a_t),$$
where $P(m)$ is the greatest prime factor of $m$. Prove that
$$g(n)=\Theta\!\left(\left(\frac{n}{\log n}\right)^{1/2}\right)\qquad(n\to\infty).$$

record.title: Erdős Problem #667 — Let $p,q\geq 1$ be fixed integers.
record.statement:
Let $p,q\geq 1$ be fixed integers. We define $H(n)=H(N;p,q)$ to be the largest $m$ such that any graph on $n$ vertices where every set of $p$ vertices spans at least $q$ edges must contain a complete graph on $m$ vertices.
Is $ c(p,q)=\liminf \frac{\log H(n)}{\log n} $ a strictly increasing function of $q$ for $1\leq q\leq \binom{p-1}{2}+1$?

record.title: Sós's conjecture for the Fano-plane-free triple-system extremal number
record.statement:
Let $F$ be the Fano configuration, the $3$-uniform hypergraph on vertices $\{x_1,x_2,x_3,a,b,c,d\}$ with edges $\{x_1,x_2,x_3\},\{x_1,a,b\},\{x_1,c,d\},\{x_2,a,c\},\{x_2,b,d\},\{x_3,a,d\},\{x_3,b,c\}$. For two disjoint sets $X$ and $\overline X$, let $H(X,\overline X)$ be the hypergraph on $X\cup\overline X$ whose edges are all triples meeting both parts. Let $H_n=H(X,\overline X)$ with $|X|=\lceil n/2\rceil$ and $|\overline X|=\lfloor n/2\rfloor$. Sós conjectured that $H_n$ gives the exact value of $\operatorname{ex}_3(n,F)$; equivalently, that
$$\operatorname{ex}_3(n,F)=\binom n3-\binom{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}3-\binom{\lceil n/2\rceil}3.$$

record.title: Exact degree and Ore-type conditions forcing a graph to be $k$-linked
record.statement:
For $k\ge 2$, let $D(n,k)$ be the minimum positive integer $d$ such that every $n$-vertex graph with minimum degree at least $d$ is $k$-linked, and let $R(n,k)$ be the minimum positive integer $r$ such that every $n$-vertex graph $G$ with $\sigma_2(G)\ge r$ is $k$-linked, where $\sigma_2(G)$ is the minimum of $\deg(u)+\deg(v)$ over all pairs of non-adjacent vertices $u,v$. Then
\[
R(n,k)=
\begin{cases}
2n-3,& n\le 3k-1,\\
\left\lfloor\dfrac{2(n+5k)}{3}\right\rfloor-3,& 3k\le n\le 4k-2,\\
n+2k-3,& n\ge 4k-1,
\end{cases}
\]
and
\[
D(n,k)=\left\lceil\dfrac{R(n,k)}2\right\rceil=
\begin{cases}
n-1,& n\le 3k-1,\\
\left\lfloor\dfrac{n+5k}{3}\right\rfloor-1,& 3k\le n\le 4k-2,\\
\left\lceil\dfrac{n-3}{2}\right\rceil+k,& n\ge 4k-1.
\end{cases}
\]

record.title: Estimation of the power index in asymmetric power GARCH approximation
record.statement:
For the volatility model $X_t=\sigma_t\varepsilon_t$, estimate the power index by choosing $\hat\gamma\in[u_0,2]$ to minimize
\[
R(\gamma)=\sum_{j=1}^{k}\sup_x\left|\frac{1}{n}\sum_{t=\nu}^{n}\hat\varepsilon_t^{(\gamma)}I(X_{t-j}\le x)\right|,
\qquad
\hat\varepsilon_t^{(\gamma)}=\frac{X_t}{\{\xi_{t,\gamma}(\hat\theta(\gamma))\}^{1/\gamma}},
\]
where $k\ge1$, $u_0>0$, and $\hat\theta(\gamma)$ is either the least-absolute-deviations or Gaussian maximum-likelihood estimator of the parameter of $\xi_{t,\gamma}$. The report states that, under regularity conditions, this estimator $\hat\gamma$ is weakly consistent.

record.title: Convergence of the successive approximations for the extreme Nekrasov wave
record.statement:
For $0\le s\le\pi$, define $\phi_0$ by $\sin\phi_0(s)=\tfrac12\cos\tfrac{s}{2}$ and define $\phi_{n+1}=T_0\phi_n$, where
\[
(T_0\phi)(s)=\frac13\int_0^\pi K(s,t)\,\frac{\sin\phi(t)}{\displaystyle\int_0^t\sin\phi(u)\,du}\,dt,
\qquad
K(s,t)=\frac1\pi\log\left|\frac{\tan\frac{s+t}{2}}{\tan\frac{|s-t|}{2}}\right|.
\]
Determine whether the sequence $(\phi_n)_{n\ge0}$ converges, and, if so, whether its limit is a solution of the extreme-wave equation $\phi=T_0\phi$.

record.title: Solvability criterion for nonlinear boundary interpolation
record.statement:
Given a smooth family of manifolds $M_t$ for $t\in\mathbb{T}$ and prescribed data $t_j\in\mathbb{T}$, $w_j\in M_{t_j}$, $j=0,\ldots,k$, determine a necessary-and-sufficient criterion for the existence of a function $w$ continuous on $\overline{\mathbb{D}}$, holomorphic in $\mathbb{D}$, satisfying
\[
w(t)\in M_t\quad(t\in\mathbb{T}),\qquad w(t_j)=w_j\quad(j=0,\ldots,k).
\]
The report states that no such solvability criterion is known even in the special case $M_t=\mathbb{T}$, associated with finite Blaschke products.

record.title: Discrepancy bounds for the multidimensional declustering hypergraph
record.statement:
For positive integers $N$ and $d$, let
$$
H_N^d=([N]^d,E_N^d),
\qquad
E_N^d=\left\{\prod_{i=1}^d[x_i..y_i]:1\le x_i\le y_i\le N\right\},
$$
where $[N]=\{1,\ldots,N\}$ and $[x_i..y_i]=\{x_i,x_i+1,\ldots,y_i\}$. For a coloring $\chi:[N]^d\to[M]$, define
$$
\operatorname{disc}^+(H_N^d,\chi)=\max_{i\in[M],\,E\in E_N^d}\left(|\chi^{-1}(i)\cap E|-\frac{|E|}{M}\right),
$$
and
$$
\operatorname{disc}^+(H_N^d,M)=\min_{\chi:[N]^d\to[M]}\operatorname{disc}^+(H_N^d,\chi).
$$
Let $q_1$ be the smallest prime power in the canonical factorization of $M$ into prime powers. Then:

1. If $d\le q_1+1$, then $\operatorname{disc}^+(H_N^d,M)=O(\log^{d-1}M)$, independently of $N\in\mathbb N$.
2. If $N\ge M$, then $\operatorname{disc}^+(H_N^d,M)=\Omega\!\left(\log^{(d-1)/2}M\right)$.

Here $M,d\ge2$.

record.title: Scarf-type resolutions for the ideals $J_\varphi$
record.statement:
Let $R=K[x_1,x_2,x_3]$, let $\varphi(r)=l+k(3-r)>0$ for $k,l\in\mathbb N$, and assume $\operatorname{char}(K)=0$ or $\operatorname{char}(K)>\sum_{i=1}^3\varphi(i)-2$. For
\[
J_\varphi=\left\langle x_1^{\varphi(1)},x_2^{\varphi(1)},x_3^{\varphi(1)},(x_1+x_2)^{2\varphi(2)},(x_1+x_3)^{2\varphi(2)},(x_2+x_3)^{2\varphi(2)},(x_1+x_2+x_3)^{3\varphi(3)}\right\rangle,
\]
determine whether $J_\varphi$ can have a Scarf-type minimal free resolution. The report notes that the displayed generators cannot themselves be used in a Taylor resolution, so a different generating set would be necessary.

record.title: Minimax expected Kullback–Leibler redundancy for Bernoulli estimation
record.statement:
For a sample of size $n$ from a Bernoulli distribution with unknown parameter $p\in[0,1]$, choose numbers $q_k\in(0,1)$, $k=0,1,\ldots,n$, where $q_k$ is used when the symbol $A_1$ occurs exactly $k$ times. Define
\[
L_{\mathrm{KL}}(p,q)=p\log\frac{p}{q}+(1-p)\log\frac{1-p}{1-q},
\]
\[
B_k^n(p)=\binom{n}{k}(1-p)^{n-k}p^k,
\qquad
F_n(p)=\sum_{k=0}^n B_k^n(p)L_{\mathrm{KL}}(p,q_k).
\]
Find $q_0,q_1,\ldots,q_n$ minimizing the worst-case redundancy
\[
\sup_{0\le p\le 1}F_n(p).
\]

record.title: Convergence and optimality of AdaBoost in the separable case
record.statement: Given a separable classification problem with data points $x_1,\dots,x_D$, hypotheses $h_j:X\eto\{-1,1\}$ for $j=1,\dots,H$, labels $y:X\eto\{-1,1\}$, and the AdaBoost iterates described by the report, do the normalized convex combinations $\widetilde\lambda_t=\lambda_t/(\sum_{j=1}^H(\lambda_t)_j)$ converge, and, if they converge, is their limit a maximizer of the minimum classification margin $\min_{1\le i\le D}\left[\left(\sum_{j=1}^H\lambda_jh_j(x_i)\right)y(x_i)\right]$?
